newsitem.title: USA: RailTex completes placement of notes.
newsitem.headline: RailTex completes placement of notes.

text.p: RailTex Inc said that effective July 22, it successfully completed the issuance, through a private placement, of $50 million of senior unsecured notes.
The notes have a fifteen year term and an average life, after mandatory prepayments, of twelve and one-half years, the company said.
The Notes bear an interest rate of 7.44 percent, the company said.
Proceeds from the Notes have been used to reduce borrowings under RailTex's U.S. acquisition bank facility, the company said.
Morgan Stanley Dean Witter served as placement agent for the notes, the company said.
